1. Enterprise SA Selection Decision Tree (R587)
Symbol-Linked Memory, Tool-Call Gates, Worktree Labs & Text2SQL
Q1: Symbol-Linked Shared Agent Memory on ClickHouse?
• ClickHouse/loom (★172, Apache-2.0, Python/TS):
Memories link directly to files & AST symbols; surface
automatically when Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor edits code
• MCP server + Python/TS SDKs self-hosted on ClickHouse
Q2: Git-Versioned Policy-as-Code Across 43 Harnesses?
• intutic/intutic (★9, MIT, TypeScript/Rust):
Synchronous tool-call gate + Rust proxy before shell/file ops
Policies are Markdown SOPs in Git; blocks kubectl delete,
out-of-scope edits, secret leaks & runaway agent loops
Q3: Frozen-Baseline Overnight Worktree Experiment Loop?
• forger-labs-hq/researchforge (★12, Apache-2.0, Python):
Freezes baseline metric, runs hypotheses in isolated Git
worktrees, auto-rejects regressions & keeps verified wins
• Works with Claude Code, Cursor, or direct LLM API keys
Q4: Enterprise Text2SQL StateGraph + Dual RAG + HITL?
• qifan777/data-agent-tutorial (★118, NOASSERTION, Kotlin):
Spring Boot 3 + Spring AI Alibaba Graph + pgvector
Dual RAG (Schema Graph + Knowledge) + SQL self-healing
• Docker Python sandbox analysis + HITL approval + A2A/SSE
2. End-to-End Governed Enterprise Coding & Data Agent Reference Architecture
Four-Pillar Control Plane: ClickHouse Symbol Memory ➔ Intutic Tool Gate ➔ ResearchForge Worktree Lab ➔ Text2SQL StateGraph
Pillar A: Symbol-Linked Memory (ClickHouse/loom)
• Code-Anchored Memory: Links team decisions & incident notes
directly to file paths and code symbols in ClickHouse
• Proactive Context Surfacing: When an agent opens or edits a
symbol, Loom automatically injects linked architectural rules
• Unified Storage: Long-term memory + doc search + code index
• Ecosystem: MCP server, Claude Code & Codex plugins, PyPI
(clickhouse-loom) & npm (@clickhouse/loom) SDKs
✓ Stops multi-agent amnesia across repos & developer sessions
Pillar B: Synchronous Tool Gate (intutic/intutic)
• Beyond LLM Gateways: Intercepts local shell, file & MCP tool
execution synchronously via a local Rust proxy & hook gates
• Markdown Policy-as-Code: SOPs stored in Git define allowed
directories, forbidden commands (e.g. kubectl delete) & scopes
• 43 Harnesses Supported: Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, CrewAI,
LangGraph, AutoGen, OpenDevin & custom MCP agents
• Protection: Redacts secrets inline & halts runaway loops
✓ Enforces zero-trust compliance at the tool-execution boundary
Pillar C: Isolated Worktree Lab (forger-labs-hq/researchforge)
• Frozen Baseline Contract: Locks benchmark score before any
autonomous agent code mutation begins
• Git Worktree Isolation: Runs each hypothesis in a disposable
worktree; automatically discards failed or regressed branches
• Dual Modes: Repository optimization mode + Kaggle competitive
notebook ingestion & iterative improvement rounds
• Human Gate: Nothing ships or submits without explicit approval
✓ Turns overnight agent coding into a monotonically improving loop
Pillar D: Enterprise Text2SQL Agent (data-agent-tutorial)
• Stack: Kotlin + Spring Boot 3.x + Spring AI Alibaba Graph
• Dual-Channel RAG: Relational schema graph + unstructured
business glossary stored in PostgreSQL + pgvector
• Execution & Self-Healing: SQL generation, syntax/runtime
traceback repair & isolated Docker Python sandbox analytics
• Production UX: Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) query confirmation,
A2A protocol interoperability & SSE streaming reports
✓ Eliminates Text2SQL schema hallucination & unsafe DB queries
3. Closed-Form FinOps TCO Verification (CLAIM-20261120-R28-R587-CLICKHOUSELOOM-INTUTIC-RESEARCHFORGE-DATAAGENT · 44 Eng @ $100/h)
Path A: Cloud Memory SaaS + Guardrail Gateways + BI Seats
• Cloud SaaS & Seat Licenses: $3,280.00 / mo
• Manual Triage & SQL Rework: 40.5 h/mo × $100.00/h = $4,050.00 / mo
• Overhead: Stale unlinked vector memories, unguarded local
shell calls, polluted git branches & hallucinated SQL joins
Path C: Self-Hosted OSS (Loom + Intutic + Forge + DataAgent)
• ClickHouse & pgvector Compute: $80.00 / mo
• Governance & Review Labor: 2.5 h/mo × $100.00/h = $250.00 / mo
• Outcome: Symbol-linked ClickHouse memory, 43-harness Rust
tool gates, isolated worktree labs & HITL Text2SQL StateGraph
Verified Closed-Form ROI & Governance Summary
• Monthly Net Savings: $7,000.00 / mo (-95.50%)
• Annualized Savings: $84,000.00 / yr
